All signs.voice_body:
LOOK AT THE SKY AND LISTEN TO WHAT IT TELLS YOU.  
On 16 September 2026 Neptune’s gentle sextile to Pluto invites a quiet deepening of imagination and truth‑seeking. It’s a slow, background shift that encourages you to let hidden insights surface without forcing them. The Venus square Pluto, a sharper trigger, reminds you that desire and power can clash—your love for something may feel threatened by a hidden fear.  

Respond by pausing to journal any sudden urges to change a relationship or creative project. Notice where you feel pulled toward a deeper meaning and where resistance appears. Acknowledge both, then decide whether to let the urge flow or hold it back.  
Today, write down one wish you’ve been holding back and one fear you’re confronting.
